commits.subject: fix(test): pin git_branch stamp in the interrupted-sync round-trip test
commits.body:
The test builds a manifest via the real sync_to_r2, whose provenance
stamp reads the CI checkout's branch — on the deploy workflow that is
'deploy', and sync_from_r2's main-branch refusal (correctly) fired.
Verified by running the test from a non-main branch before committing.
